description: Alex's chat note, 2026-07-08: "Unicode text emoji support"; he confirmed 2026-10-25 that he means text emoticons such as ¯\_(ツ)_/¯, (╯°□°)╯︵ ┻━┻ and ( ͡° ͜ʖ ͡°). The picker's list (Resources/emojis.json, 1903 entries) holds only color emoji, so these have to be typed or copied from elsewhere. Wanted: emoticons searchable by name in the same picker, inserted as plain text.
title: Text emoticons alongside emoji
